A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the performance of the Amplicor HIV DNA PCR assay following DNA extraction by MP is comparable with the manual extraction procedure and is therefore a viable alternative to be used in low resource setting for early infant diagnosis.

the performance of the assay with manual extraction and processing of DBS samples is comparable with that of the manual extraction performed on the cell pellet and the automated extraction performed on venous blood and cell pellets.

the use of MP is an efficient alternative to the manual method for HIV-1 PCR testing of venous blood or DBS samples.
MP can be used for HIV-1 PCR testing of DBS samples and that it has the advantage of being automated.
the use of DBS samples with automated DNA extraction method can be a good alternative for early infant diagnosis in resource limited settings where there is limited access to laboratory facilities.
